data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Optical Character Recognition using Tesseract and Apple Vision.
data.what_it_does: Extracts text from images using the Tesseract engine on Android/iOS and Apple Vision on iOS. It supports unicode, multiple languages via trained data files, and configurable OCR options.
use_when: You need on-device text recognition from images using Tesseract or Apple Vision.
You need support for multiple languages through .traineddata files.
avoid_when: You only need barcode or QR code scanning rather than general OCR.
You want to avoid manual iOS CocoaPods configuration and framework file placement.
strengths: Supports multiple engines (Tesseract and Apple Vision).
Configurable options like language, page segmentation mode, and engine mode.
weaknesses: Requires manual addition of language trained data files and assets configuration.
Requires manual iOS steps including downloading and placing libtesseract.xcframework.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding language .traineddata files and tessdata_config.json to assets and configuring pubspec.yaml. iOS requires manual placement of libtesseract.xcframework and custom Podfile paths.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you specifically need barcode and QR code scanning instead of full text OCR.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you want a complete camera preview and capture solution.
